text: No fires were detected on the property in the two weeks before 2026-10-04. Satellite data from NASA FIRMS (using sensors VIIRS and MODIS) showed zero thermal anomalies within the asset boundaries during that period. All sensors had full coverage every day, meaning no active fires were observed. However, small or short-lived fires might not have been detected due to limitations like cloud cover or low heat output. The evidence does not confirm whether any burned areas existed or what caused them, but official records indicate no confirmed fires during this time.
